headline: Microsoft and Nvidia put a $2,599 AI laptop on the table, Crew-12 splashes down this afternoon, and Antonelli takes his 84-point lead into the season's final sprint weekend in Singapore.

F1 Singapore GP — Sprint Sat 11:00, Qualifying Sat 15:00, Race Sun 14:00 (Irish time)
UFC Vegas 122: Allen vs Duncan — Apex, Las Vegas (main card ~01:00 Sun Irish time)
Valor Mortis and Planet Zoo 2 release
Surface Laptop Ultra and other RTX Spark Windows PCs go on sale

items.headline: Microsoft unveils the $2,599 Surface Laptop Ultra
items.summary: Yesterday's San Francisco event confirmed the Nvidia RTX Spark-powered Surface Ultra, with RTX Spark machines from Asus, Dell, HP and Lenovo also coming; all go on sale 16 October. Windows also gets a Copilot that mixes local and cloud models, plus Meta's Muse agent.

items.headline: Event recap: the rest of Microsoft's AI-PC pitch
items.summary: Full rundown of the Surface and Windows announcements, including the agent-security model that fences off what AI agents can do on your PC.

items.headline: Crew-12 is on its way home — splashdown this afternoon
items.summary: Dragon undocked from the ISS at 13:05 Irish time yesterday and is due to splash down off California at about 16:34 Irish time today (correction: yesterday's brief had the wrong time). ESA's Sophie Adenot is aboard.

items.headline: Picture of the day: the strange supernova remnant Pa 30
items.summary: NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day features Pa 30, the leftover of a rare, oddly 'failed' stellar explosion linked to a guest star recorded in 1181, with its distinctive firework-like filaments.

items.headline: 2XKO gets its final two champions on 27 October
items.summary: Riot's tag fighter is winding down: the last characters land on 27 October, active development ends this year with a final fix patch in December, and servers stay up with all champions unlocked and recent spending refunded.

items.headline: Watchlist: quiet day
items.summary: Nothing new on The Witcher 4, Cyberpunk 2, Witcher 3 Remastered or Borderlands 4 since yesterday's crossover news. Valor Mortis and Planet Zoo 2 arrive next Tuesday.

items.headline: Light weekend after No-Gi Pans
items.summary: Quiet news day. On the mats this weekend: UIJJ Adriatico Cup (Fri), Fight to Win 328 in Philadelphia (Sat) and Main Character Jiu-Jitsu 10 in Miami (Sun).

items.headline: England's Christian Leroy Duncan gets his first UFC main event
items.summary: The #10-ranked middleweight (15-2, five straight wins) headlines UFC Vegas 122 against Brendan Allen on Saturday and says the spot is an opportunity rather than extra pressure. One for UK fans.

items.headline: Singapore start times: final sprint weekend of 2026
items.summary: Marina Bay hosts the last sprint of the season — single practice Friday, sprint 11:00 and qualifying 15:00 Saturday, race 14:00 Sunday (Irish time).

items.headline: Williams swap reserves for Singapore
items.summary: Victor Martins, also an Alpine WEC Hypercar driver, steps in as Williams reserve while Luke Browning races Super Formula at Fuji.

items.headline: Marina Bay weather watch
items.summary: Forecast for the weekend, with the usual threat of tropical storms hanging over a night race.
